text:
jordan-cs: FYI — Acme reported 403s hitting the batch rerank endpoint (/v1/rerank/batch) after their SSO/IDP migration. Single item rerank + embeddings still work. Started ~09:12 UTC.

alex-support: Ack. Can you paste a sanitized request/headers + error body? Also which tenant/org?

jordan-cs: Tenant: acme-prod. Sample failure (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/rerank/batch
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "error": {
    "code": 403,
    "message": "missing_entitlement: rerank",
    "details": []
  }
}
```

alex-support: Hmm looks like token doesn't have the rerank entitlement. Did they rotate keys during migration?

sam-eng: Quick check from logs: the token's claim payload shows entitlements but parsed value when provisioner created the svc token is missing "rerank". On staging I see IDP emitted a space-delimited string for groups instead of an array, and our CSV/comma-only parser dropped the last token if no comma present.

maria-iam: Can we get the raw id_token claim (redact PII)? Specifically the claim used by the provisioner: `entitlements` or `scopes`. Past bugs: whitespace-delimited lists became a single string that our parser didn't split.

jordan-cs: Provided snippet from their id_token (sanitized):
```
{"sub":"...","email":"ops@acme.com","entitlements":"inference embeddings rerank"}
```

sam-eng: There it is — entitlements is a space-separated string. Our provisioner parsing expects either an array or comma-separated string. Because there was no comma, we treated the whole value as one entitlement and then mapping code attempted to canonicalize and ended up losing rerank during the create flow for service tokens. Repro steps (staging):
1) Configure IDP SCIM/JWT mapping to emit `entitlements` as a space-separated string.
2) Run provisioner create flow: `POST /internal/provisioner/provision` with id_token.
3) Observe svc token created with entitlements `["inference","embeddings"]` (no rerank).
4) Calls to `/v1/rerank/batch` return 403.

maria-iam: Temporary mitigation for the customer: create a console API key and manually add rerank entitlement, or update the provisioner mapping to emit an array or comma-separated list. I'll send exact UI steps to customer.

alex-support: I created a temporary API key for acme-prod with full entitlements and shipped it to their security contact (copied). They validated that batch rerank now works end-to-end. Customer wants a permanent fix — we should patch the provisioner.

triage-bot: Incident INC-2026-123 opened (severity: P2) — root cause: provisioner parsing failure for whitespace-delimited entitlement claims.

sam-eng: I'll open a PR to normalize entitlement parsing (accept arrays, comma, space, semicolon). Quick fix target: parse by regex /[\s,;]+/ and trim — rolling to staging now. ETA ~3h.

jordan-cs: Thanks. Customer confirmed success with temp key and will wait for the patch before doing full IDP cutover. Please post PR and deploy links here.

alex-support: Noted. I'll follow up with a knowledge base entry for tenants using non-standard SCIM/JWT mappings.

sam-eng: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/provisioner/pull/542 (draft) — added robust splitting + unit tests. Will request review.

jordan-cs: Great work. Leaving this open until patch is prod-deployed and Acme confirms they can migrate without the manual key. :thumbsup:
